A '''raccoon''' was a type of [[Species/Legends|creature]] with a [[Color/Legends|black]] mask across their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SotE" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> when the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] disguised himself as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Snoova]] as part of a plan to infiltrate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] [[Xizor's Palace|fortress]], his disguise gave him a raccoonlike mark across his eyes.<ref name="SotE" /> The [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="Mycroftsystem">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}, per corresponding information for the [[Mycroft system/Legends|Mycroft system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]] had a large [[Unidentified bear-like creature|creature]] that, while similar in appearance to a [[black bear]], had [[Limb/Legends|hands]] like those of a raccoon.<ref name="M13">{{WEGCite|story=Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Raccoons were first mentioned in [[Paul Murphy]]'s [[1988]] [[roleplaying game]] scenario "[[Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|Assault on Repair Station M13]]." The scenario was created for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''.<ref name="M13" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Raccoon|raccoons]] are omnivorous furred mammals with bandit-like masks across their eyes.<ref name="NatGeo">{{WebCite|url=https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/mammals/r/raccoon|text=Raccoon|work=[[Wikipedia:National Geographic|National Geographic]]|archivedate=20200428204741}}</ref>
